title: A stop outside service
body: The direct-channel light opens before the report. M.: ‘Operator. Elevator telemetry is a Facilities concern.’ There is no Facilities extension on the night roster. ‘Yes,’ M. adds. ‘That is what makes this easy. File the fault and do your actual job.’ SECONDARY ORDER — Municipal Annex, car 2. At 00:59:57 the elevator stopped above Floor 11. Service field: FLOOR 12. Requesting operator: your terminal ID. You were not on shift yet.

choices.label: Clear it as an out-of-range sensor fault.

outcome.text: The field corrects itself to FLOOR 11 before your confirmation finishes. For one frame, a restricted attachment reads: FIELD VISIT — SENIOR OPERATOR ONLY. ‘Thank you,’ M. says. ‘See? We can have a normal conversation.’ The direct channel closes before you can answer.

choices.label: Trace the request before filing it.

outcome.text: The request carries your terminal ID, your timestamp format, and a signature shaped like yours. The direct-channel light is still on. ‘That is not a question you need answered,’ M. says. A pause. ‘For what it is worth, I also dislike that signature.’ The attachment ends at a clearance seal: SENIOR OPERATOR. A new line appears in your file: PROMOTION REVIEW ACTIVE.
